'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Rafah offensive]]

**[[2024 Kharkiv offensive]]
***[[Russia]] claims that its [[Russian Ground Forces|troops]] have entered the town of [[Vovchansk]], {{conv|74|km|mi}} from [[Kharkiv]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crgyymn8y3ro (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[GameStop short squeeze]]
**Three years after the previous [[GameStop]] stock squeeze, [[Reddit]]ors return to [[market manipulation|artificially inflate]] GameStop's [[share price]] by 75%, reaching an 18-month high. The share price of [[AMC Theatres]] also increases by more than 70%. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/gamestop-jumps-after-roaring-kitty-returns-following-three-year-hiatus-2024-05-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/05/13/gme-jumps-as-trader-roaring-kitty-who-drove-meme-craze-posts-again.html (CNBC)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs a bill banning imports of [[uranium]] from [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/biden-signs-ban-imports-russian-nuclear-reactor-fuel-into-law-2024-05-14/ (''Reuters'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2024/05/13/russian-uranium-imports-ban/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing heavy [[flood]]ing in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 147 people, with 127 people still missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-floods-southern-brazil-hits-147-2024-05-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse]]
**The final remains of the collapsed [[Francis Scott Key Bridge (Baltimore)|Francis Scott Key Bridge]] in [[Baltimore]], [[Maryland]], [[United States]], which killed six workers, are demolished with explosives. [https://www.eastbaytimes.com/2024/05/13/explosives-bring-down-remains-of-collapsed-baltimore-bridge/ (''East Bay Times'')]
*The death toll from the [[flash flood]] and [[lahar]] in [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], increases to 43, with 15 others still missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/floods-kill-37-indonesias-west-sumatra-17-missing-2024-05-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mumbai billboard collapse]]
**At least 17 people are killed, 75 are injured, and others are trapped after a billboard collapses during heavy rains in [[Mumbai]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/four-dead-several-feared-trapped-under-billboard-freak-accident-during-mumbai-2024-05-13/ (Reuters)] [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/mumbai/ghatkopar-hoarding-crash-death-toll-rises-victim-hospitals-9344361/ (The Indian Express)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Airlines for America]] trade association and several major [[U.S.|American]] airlines file a lawsuit against the [[United States Department of Transportation]] over a rule requiring upfront disclosure of airline fees. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/major-airlines-sue-biden-administration-over-fee-disclosure-rule-2024-05-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Indonesia]]n police conducts a major drug raid on a lab hidden in a villa in [[Bali]], Indonesia. They arrested one Indonesian, two [[Ukraine|Ukrainians]], and one Russian. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-bali-drugs-hydroponic-marijuana-labs-aa525a3a6b4f7707b1106e1355796630 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Lithuanian constitutional referendum]]
**A referendum to allow [[dual citizenship]] in [[Lithuania]] fails to pass. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/2271366/lithuania-s-citizenship-referendum-fails-to-pass-constitutional-amendments (LRT)]
*[[2024 Lithuanian presidential election]]
**[[Gitanas Nausėda]] and [[Ingrida Šimonytė]] advance to the run-off election, which will be held on 26 May. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/12/lithuania-presidential-election-gitanas-nauseda-ukraine-russia-threat (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**The [[High Commissioner of the Republic in New Caledonia|High Commissioner]] of [[New Caledonia]] imposes a curfew and mobilizes security forces after a [[general strike]] and violent protests over proposed constitutional changes in the capital city [[Nouméa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/14/new-caledonia-security-forces-deployed-curfew-imposed-after-violence (Al Jazeera)]
*An administrative court in [[Münster]], [[Germany]], rules that the [[Alternative for Germany]] political party could threaten democracy and can be spied on. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/05/13/germany-afd-extremist-party-court/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Science and technology'''
